018package org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation;
019
020import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.ANNOTATION_TYPE;
021import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.CONSTRUCTOR;
022import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.FIELD;
023import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.LOCAL_VARIABLE;
024import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.METHOD;
025import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.MODULE;
026import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.PACKAGE;
027import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.PARAMETER;
028import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT;
029import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.TYPE;
030import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.TYPE_PARAMETER;
031import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.TYPE_USE;
032import static java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME;
033import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
034
035import java.lang.annotation.Documented;
036import java.lang.annotation.Repeatable;
037import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
038import java.lang.annotation.Target;
039
040import org.apiguardian.api.API;
041
042/**
043 *  <p>{@summary This annotation allows to add information about applied fixes
044 *  (aka. &quot;Change Requests&quot;) to a program element.}</p>
045 *  <p>This annotation does not appear in the Javadoc documentation of the
046 *  annotated program elements.</p>
047 *
048 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
049 *  @version $Id: BUG.java 1118 2024-03-15 16:14:15Z tquadrat $
050 *  @since 0.25.14
051 *
052 *  @UMLGraph.link
053 */
054@SuppressWarnings( "NewClassNamingConvention" )
055@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: BUG.java 1118 2024-03-15 16:14:15Z tquadrat $" )
056@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.14" )
057@Retention( RUNTIME )
058@Target( {ANNOTATION_TYPE, CONSTRUCTOR, FIELD, LOCAL_VARIABLE, METHOD, MODULE, PACKAGE, PARAMETER, RECORD_COMPONENT, TYPE, TYPE_PARAMETER, TYPE_USE} )
059@Repeatable( ChangeRequestList.class )
060public @interface CR
061{
062        /*---------------*\
063    ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
064        \*---------------*/
065    /**
066     *  <p>{@summary Types of change requests.}</p>
067     *
068     *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
069     *  @version $Id: BUG.java 1118 2024-03-15 16:14:15Z tquadrat $
070     *  @since 0.25.14
071     *
072     *  @UMLGraph.link
073     */
074    @ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: BUG.java 1118 2024-03-15 16:14:15Z tquadrat $" )
075    @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.14" )
076    public enum CRType
077    {
078        /**
079         *  <p>{@summary The implementation of a generic change request.}</p>
080         */
081        @SuppressWarnings( "FieldNamingConvention" )
082        CR,
083
084        /**
085         *  <p>{@summary A bug fix.}</p>
086         */
087        @SuppressWarnings( "FieldNamingConvention" )
088        BUG,
089
090        /**
091         *  <p>{@summary A patch for debugging purposes; perhaps only temporary.}</p>
092         */
093        DEBUG,
094
095        /**
096         *  <p>{@summary The implementation of an enhancement request.}</p>
097         */
098        @SuppressWarnings( "FieldNamingConvention" )
099        ENH,
100
101        /**
102         *  <p>{@summary A field service patch.}</p>
103         */
104        @SuppressWarnings( "FieldNamingConvention" )
105        FSP,
106
107        /**
108         *  <p>{@summary A maintenance patch.}</p>
109         */
110        PATCH,
111
112        /**
113         *  <p>{@summary A change that was required by a new version of the
114         *  product.} Use this type if there is no change request id for this
115         *  particular change. Use the new version as the
116         *  {@linkplain #id() id}.</p>
117         */
118    }
119    //  enum CRType
120
121        /*------------*\
122    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
123        \*------------*/
124    /**
125     *  <p>{@summary An optional comment regarding the change.}</p>
126     *
127     *  @return The comment.
128     */
129    String comment() default "";
130
131    /**
132     *  <p>{@summary The date when the change was applied, in the format
133     *  &quot;YYYY-mm-dd&quot;.} Will be ignored if empty.</p>
134     *
135     *  @return The change date.
136     *
137     *  @see java.util.Formatter
138     */
139    String date() default "";
140
141    /**
142     *  <p>{@summary The id for the change request as provided by the
143     *  respective tracking system.}</p>
144     *
145     *  @return The change request id.
146     */
147    @SuppressWarnings( "NewMethodNamingConvention" )
148    String id();
149
150    /**
151     *  <p>{@summary The type for the change request.}</p>
152     *
153     *  @return The type of the change request.
154     */
155    CRType type() default CRType.CR;
156}
157//  @interface BUG
158
159/*
160 *  End of File
161 */
